project_type: pnpm-workspace TypeScript monorepo (~34 packages). Backend: Fastify HTTP services (apps/control-plane-api). Front-end: Next.js App Router apps (apps/merchant-console). Live infra: Supabase Postgres, Fly.io (control-plane-api, agent-runtime, worker in sin), Vercel projects.
build_system: pnpm 9.15.4 workspaces. Root scripts: pnpm build = pnpm -r run build (tsc per package). NODE SETUP REQUIRED at start of EVERY bash command: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.

contribution_requirements: Tenant isolation is a hard requirement: a merchant may only read THEIR OWN transactions; cross-merchant reads must be blocked (403/404). Never drop/truncate/migrate the shared schema; integration tests clean up only their own rows. The 4 Next apps intentionally use transpilePackages:[@counter/ui] + typescript.ignoreBuildErrors + eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds -- do NOT revert. Do NOT redefine the front-end Transaction type or the listTransactions/getTransaction client signatures; implement the backend to satisfy them. Do NOT change deployed limits, spend-ledger, or worker money-seam logic. Do NOT git add/commit/push.
key_patterns: BACKEND route pattern (mirror exactly): apps/control-plane-api/src/policy-routes.ts defines a typed store PORT interface + in-memory impl (createInMemory...) + a Fastify plugin (policyRoutesPlugin) that (a) calls registerRoutePermission(GET:<route>, { permission: identity.scope.read }) and (b) enforces tenant access via verifyTenantAccess(request, merchantId) reading getActorContext(request).scope: platform=>allow, merchant=>scope.merchantId===merchantId, else 403. The Postgres adapter lives in a sibling file (policy-store-postgres.ts) wrapping a @counter/data repository and is wired in main.ts from DATABASE_URL, injected via CreateServerOptions; in-memory store used for local/test/development. Register the new plugin in src/index.ts createServer(). Raw SQL via database.query<Row>(text, params) on TransactionalDatabase (from @counter/data PostgresDatabase). ActorContext.scope is a discriminated union {kind:platform|merchant|wallet, merchantId?, walletId?}. FRONT-END pattern: pages are 'use client'; fetch via useApi(client => client.listTransactions(merchantId), [merchantId]); render loading via Skeleton, empty via EmptyState({icon,title,description}), error via ErrorState({title?,message?,onRetry?,retryLabel?}); DataTable takes columns + data. Derive merchantId the same way other authed pages do (check src/lib/identity.ts / auth.ts).
read_model_mapping: Front-end Transaction (src/lib/types.ts) assembled from runtime tables. SPINE = runtime.workflow_intents filtered to environment + scope_kind=merchant + scope_id=<merchantId>: transactionId<-transaction_id, merchantId<-scope_id, createdAt<-created_at, status basis<-status. amount<-runtime.spend_ledger.amount_minor joined by reference=transaction_id, MINOR->MAJOR (divide by 100 for INR; demo amount:1500 rendered INR 1,500 => MAJOR expected). currency<-INR literal (cross-check spend_ledger.currency). transitions[] and currentState<-ordered runtime.lifecycle_steps joined by idempotency_key=transaction_id (steps shopify.draft/finalize/markPaid + .claim; status completed|declined; reference=provider order id=evidenceRef; created_at/completed_at=>timestamp; actor derived from step). Map terminal derived state to TransactionState via an explicit documented step->state function; intent.status=failed or a declined step => failed. GAPS (no real source, FLAG as documented gaps, do NOT invent): buyerRef (no buyer column; authority_context jsonb MAY carry it -> surface null/unavailable), method (no payment-method column; snapshot currently always null -> surface documented unknown/default). lifecycle_steps has NO scope column, so tenant scoping MUST go through workflow_intents.scope_id; getTransaction(id) resolves the intent, verifies scope_id matches caller merchant scope, else 404/403.
